description: DialogflowCompanionAgent is the Schema for the DialogflowCompanionAgent API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DialogflowCompanionAgentSpec defines the desired state of DialogflowCompanionAgent

cesToolSpecs.description: Optional. List of CES tool specs that the companion agent can choose from.

cesToolRef.description: Optional. Format: `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/apps/<app ID>/tools/<tool ID>`.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CesTool resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{appID}}/tools/{{toolID}}".

confirmationRequirement.description: Optional. Indicates whether the tool requires human confirmation.

description.description: Optional. Description for the companion agent.

displayName.description: Optional. Display name for the companion agent. Character limit is 63.

location.description: The location that this resource belongs to.

projectRef.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The DialogflowCompanionAgent name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

skillConfigs.description: Optional. List of skill configs for the companion agent. Allows at most one instance of each [SkillConfig][google.cloud.dialogflow.v2.CompanionAgent.SkillConfig] type.

actions.description: Optional. The action items that can be processed.

description.description: Required. Description of action item. It can be a agent action (e.g. "Send a message to the customer", "greet the customer") or system action (e.g. "Update the ticket", "Create a task", "cancel the order").

condition.description: Optional. The condition of the instruction. For example, "the customer wants to cancel an order".  If the users want the instruction to be triggered unconditionally, the condition can be empty.

disableSuggestedReply.description: Optional. Whether to disable suggested reply generation for this instruction. When set to `true`, guidance generated from this instruction will not include a suggested reply. Default is `false` (suggested reply enabled).

displayDetails.description: Optional. The detailed description of this instruction.

displayName.description: Optional. Display name for the instruction. This name should be unique within the companion agent.

triggerEvent.description: Optional. Event that triggers the guidance instruction. If UNSPECIFIED, the instruction triggering will be the same as the skill's skill_triggering_event.

knowledgeSource.description: Optional. Knowledge source configuration for guidance.

overarchingGuidance.description: Optional. This is specific additional guidance that can configured by the user.

skillTriggeringEvent.description: Optional. The event that should trigger the skill.

agentLanguageCode.description: Optional. Target language code for the agent, in IETF BCP-47 format (e.g., "en-US").

customerLanguageCode.description: Optional. Target language code for the customer, in IETF BCP-47 format (e.g., "es").

toolsetTools.description: Optional. List of CES toolset specs that the companion agent can choose from.

confirmationRequirement.description: Optional. Indicates whether the tool requires human confirmation.

operationID.description: Optional. The operationId field of the OpenAPI endpoint. The operationId must be present in the toolset's definition.

toolsetRef.description: Required. The name of the toolset to retrieve the schema for. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/toolsets/{toolset}`

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CesToolset resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{appID}}/toolsets/{{toolsetID}}".

status.description: DialogflowCompanionAgentStatus defines the config connector machine state of DialogflowCompanionAgent

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the DialogflowCompanionAgent resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. Creation time of this companion agent.

updateTime.description: Output only. Update time of this companion agent.
